about_the_game:
STRIKER HERO is an arcade action input game!

Strike the inputs FAST, or be defeated!

-

STRIKER HERO is a difficult, fast-paced action game, with arcade-style gameplay, designed for gamers who enjoy pushing their limits and mastering their skills!

You, the player, will have your reflexes tested in this intense action game!

STRIKER HERO is notable for its epic metal soundtrack and highly addicting mechanical skill gameplay. Players who enjoy epic action and skill mastery will enjoy this game!

Master your skills!

Complete the levels!

Unlock new weapons!

And become the true STRIKER HERO!

-

INFORMATION

STRIKER HERO is controlled with a computer mouse and keyboard.

The player uses the mouse to interact with the user interface elements, and the core gameplay actions are handled with keyboard inputs.

The player uses the keyboard's arrow keys, or the IJKL keys to handle the directional inputs, and the ZXC or QWE keys to handle the square, circle, and triangle inputs.

The escape key is used to navigate menus and toggle the in-game pause menu.

The space bar is used to begin or end specific gameplay sessions.

The duration of the game depends upon the player's individual skill level. On average, one can expect to complete the game within 45-90 minutes.

The Learning Mode feature allows for players to improve their skills at their own pace.

For an affordable price, you can enjoy an intense, addicting, and highly memorable gaming experience.

Thank you for looking at my game. I hope you have fun playing it.
